description: Nonzero test floor per Python test suite (Spec 19 R19-10, R19-12). CI discovers collectable test directories from the tree and fails when a suite reports fewer than min_tests collected tests. Discovery is enforced fail-closed by scripts/check_python_tests.py: every directory holding a pytest-collectable file (test_*.py / *_test.py) MUST have a row here (and every row MUST name an existing suite), so a new Python suite cannot escape the Python test run.

suites.applicability: required always: the gate/regression scripts and their red-on-drift self-tests
required when present: illustrative config-loader example; tests exist (32 collected), so it is tested, not SKIP
